**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

The agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, or shortfall mechanic against Sparkling:

- **§11 Fees (p0084)** — payment is limited to the fees set out in the Fee Schedule; no committed volume or spend floor.
- **§2 Grant of License (p0028)** — additional fees arise only if we elect to use the Software outside the Authorized Locations, i.e. usage-based.
- **§10 Maintenance (p0065)** — maintenance runs on a "renewable one-year term," not a locked multi-year non-cancellable commitment.
- **§17(b) (p0118)** — we may terminate at any time on 90 days' written notice, giving a clean exit from the annual fee stream.

The §3 restrictions and the Authorized Locations/copy limits constrain how we may use the Software; they are not commitments to purchase volume, so they fall outside this rule. Searches for "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay", "commit" and "purchase" returned no commitment language.
